name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: Phin Odelic leads a band of adventurers looking into odd happenings in the area, and believes the undead are involved. Two companions, Quae and Kinelory, headed for Go'Shek Farm, in the Arathi Highlands. No word has come from them for days.

sections.title: Odd Happenings
sections.body: Not long ago, a cousin of Phin's in Hillsbrad had to put down his dog, Stanley. The beast had mystically swollen to a huge size and savagely turned on anyone who came near. Phin believes the undead are involved in the odd happenings, and the group is looking for signs to prove it.

sections.title: The Missing Companions
sections.body: Quae and Kinelory, two of Phin's companions, headed into the Arathi Highlands, to Go'Shek Farm, and have not checked in for days. Phin grows concerned and wants you to find them near the farm.

aliases: who gives hints of a new plague
faq.answer: Phin leads a band of adventurers who are looking into odd happenings in the area.
Stanley was the dog of Phin's cousin in Hillsbrad. The beast mystically swelled to a huge size and savagely turned on anyone who came near, so the cousin put it down.

faq.q: Where are Quae and Kinelory supposed to be?
faq.answer: Near Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands, where they set out for. Phin has not heard from them for days.
Phin believes the undead are involved in the odd happenings in the area, and the group is looking for signs to prove it.
